title: Invertibility of the prescribed open evaluation mate
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, an open immersion j:U→X, any exact ordinary Open a of [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data], and n≥0, the inverse mate of the fixed pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation.hom under a.adj and finiteOpenAdj is an isomorphism of functors from the full derived system category of U to the finite derived category of X. The comparison is the specified mate, including the empty open and arbitrary unbounded complexes.

source.place: Strict-system realization: the construction argument recorded in lem-sf-integral-system-operation-models; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10, Stacks 03DI, 09AE, 0E8I and 0941.

proof.text: Apply ordinaryOpenFiniteEvaluation to the supplied ordinary open adjunction. It gives an invertible evaluation comparison and its counit equation in the specified level-pullback coordinates. Transport the finite adjunction on the right along pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic. Its inverse and forward components cancel in the counit equation. The adjunction Hom equivalence and mateEquiv_counit identify the inverse of this comparison with the inverse mate of the ordinary composite of pullbackTensorSequenceInverseEvaluation inverse and pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic. Finally use left-adjoint uniqueness to replace the finite left adjoint by sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero without changing invertibility.

Map the ordinary composite comparison degreewise to cochain complexes. HomologicalComplex.hom_ext and the degreewise identity components of mapHomologicalComplexCompIso show that it is the prescribed inverse-evaluation-complex comparison followed by the intrinsic finite comparison. The exactSquare_fac identity therefore proves that its standard derived square satisfies pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluationNormalization. Uniqueness in pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation_existsUnique identifies that derived square with the fixed comparison in the statement.

Apply exact_localization_inverse_mate to the ordinary adjunctions and ordinary comparison. All six functors are additive and exact. The ordinary inverse mate is invertible by the first step, so its inverse mate under the specified exact localized adjunctions is invertible. Substitute the equality of derived comparisons from the second step. These localized adjunctions are definitionally a.adj and finiteOpenAdj. No boundedness, support, or nonempty-open assumption has been introduced.

proof_origin.place: Y6: use the existing ordinary finite-evaluation counit theorem, identify the mate by the Hom equivalence, and descend with exact_localization_inverse_mate; identify the fixed normalization using exactSquare_fac and uniqueness.

theorem integralSystemOpenEvaluation_isIso {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (a : Open l E j) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((mateEquiv a.adj (finiteOpenAdj l E j n)).symm
      (pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E j n).hom).natTrans
